scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background

At 0.5 and 1 cm/px a distinct dark tapered silhouette appears inside the rectangle, running from lower-left tail/flukes toward upper-right nose. At 2 cm/px a smaller animal-shaped silhouette remains distinguishable. At 3 and 4 cm/px a small dark tapered mark remains distinguishable, with limited anatomical detail at contact-sheet scale.
The boxed dark form is spatially separate from the large pale background animal at all five GSDs. Its corresponding form and rectangle are absent in negatives.

Unlabelled background animals occupy corresponding locations across paired rows. No pronounced background shading/detail difference is apparent at contact-sheet scale here; this does not establish bitwise or photometric RGB equality.
